reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Gustav Söderström.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Gustav Söderström. Gustav is the Co-President, Chief Product Officer & Chief Technology Officer at Spotify. Gustav lets us behind the scenes on how Spotify thinks about the future of audio and video. He shares fascinating insights on their synchronized team structure and how they have positioned themselves as "the R&D department" for the entire music industry.

key_points.text: Gustav lets us behind the scenes on how Spotify thinks about the future of audio and video.
We discuss their integration of AI, their unique "bets board" process for allocating resources.
Please enjoy my conversation with Gustav Söderström.
